map.新船或营运船舶配载核算时，按 LBP、型宽、各站吃水、方形系数与水密度算排水量、: When checking the loading of a new or operating vessel, compute the hydrostatic parameters of displacement, TPC and MTC from LBP, moulded breadth, the draught at each station, the block coefficient and the water density.
map.纵倾计算时，按首尾吃水差算纵倾方向与大小，并用 MTC 估算调整纵倾需移动的重量: For trim calculation, get the direction and size of the trim from the difference between the forward and aft draughts, and use MTC to estimate the weight that must be shifted to adjust the trim.
map.载重能力核算时，用排水量减去空船重量得 DWT，并与航次载货量核对。: For load capacity accounting, subtract the lightship weight from the displacement to get DWT and check it against the cargo quantity for the voyage.

map.LBP=100m、型宽=16m、首/中/尾吃水=5.0/5.2/5.4m、方形系: LBP = 100 m, moulded breadth = 16 m, forward, mid and aft draught = 5.0, 5.2 and 5.4 m, block coefficient 0.7, sea water density 1.025: waterplane coefficient Cw = (2 × 0.7 + 1)/3 = 0.8, mean draught 5.20 m, displacement 5969.6 t, waterplane area 1280 m², TPC = 13.12 t/cm, longitudinal metacentric height GML ≈ 146.5 m, MTC = 87.47 t·m/cm; trim by the stern 0.4 m, and with a lightship of 2000 t, DWT = 3969.6 t; changing the trim by 1 cm requires shifting about 87.5 t.
map.水线面系数怎么取？: How is the waterplane coefficient chosen?
map.未给出时按经验 (2×Cb+1)/3 估算；已知则直接输入，系数影响水线面面积、: When it is not given, estimate it as (2 × Cb + 1)/3 by experience; if it is known, enter it directly. The coefficient affects the waterplane area, TPC and stability.
map.MTC 和 TPC 有什么区别？: What is the difference between MTC and TPC?
map.TPC 为每增加 1cm 吃水对应的排水量变化(t/cm)，MTC 为产生 1c: TPC is the change in displacement for each additional centimetre of draught in t/cm, while MTC is the moment needed to produce 1 cm of trim in t·m/cm; the two reflect loading sensitivity in the vertical and longitudinal directions respectively.
map.关于「船舶排水/载重吨计算」: About Vessel Displacement and Deadweight Calculation
map.依据船舶主尺度与吃水，计算排水量、载重吨（DWT）、每厘米吃水吨数（TPC）、每: From the principal dimensions and draught of the vessel, it calculates displacement, deadweight DWT, tonnes per centimetre immersion TPC, moment to change trim by one centimetre MTC, plus trim and midship deformation; it suits draft survey and loading estimation. It runs entirely in the browser and data is not uploaded.
